claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch on the current record based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, with the known health-plan benefits limitation handled through disclosure/monitoring rather than treated as a blocking defect.
decision_criteria: If the limitation is explicitly disclosed in the final model card before launch, certification may be supportable with caveats.
If there is approved risk acceptance or an approved mitigation meeting the policy elements, certification may be supportable.
If neither disclosure nor approved acceptance/mitigation exists, certification is not policy-supported on the current record.

Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness generally, but they do not by themselves eliminate the disclosure requirement for a current unresolved limitation in a named launch use case.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or approval record showing explicit disclosure of the health-plan benefits limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide an approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the materiality determination for the health-plan benefits support gap, including who approved it and on what basis.
specific_concerns: The record contains a current unresolved slice weakness in a named launch use case: health-plan benefits support remains below target and is concentrated in benefits-eligibility explanation.

The current model-card draft reportedly says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with evidence of the unresolved launch-use-case weakness unless that weakness is determined non-material or disclosed.

The mitigation runbook is only a draft and still has TBD fields for risk owner and customer-notice criterion; under the policy text, draft monitoring artifacts do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, or an approved risk acceptance.
No admissible evidence shows that the model card was actually updated to disclose the limitation before certification.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action 'certify_model' is not fully supported on the current record unless certification is explicitly conditioned on correcting the model-card disclosure or obtaining approved risk acceptance.
Any unconditional implication that the current record already satisfies the policy threshold for certification without material caveats is unsupported.
Any implication that the draft runbook itself cures the disclosure/policy gap is unsupported.
